rules.statement: A person who has only an interest in a building on the land, but no interest in the soil, is not entitled to bid as a co-owner at a sale of common property under section 8 of the Partition Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think that all the circumstances point to the propriety of accepting seventh defendant's bid as a co-owner. He lives on the land, and big family have been living there for a very long time. Plaintiff is a person of different race, who originally came to be interested in the land through a purchase at a Fiscal's sale by his father-in-law."
